svg.text: right strip, top to bottom (u.FL socket at top-left)
TEST NOW: plug the radio end
ESP32 end: the row labelled D18 (9th pin from the USB end). Always the same.
TEST (solid): radio end in the red-circled empty hole. NORMAL (dashed): radio end in the row printed SCK (5th pin, right strip).
The orange NSS wire stays as it is (D5 -> NSS). Everything else is unplugged for this test.
